verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page claiming it helps customers achieve and maintain certification, so ISO 27001 is offered as a supported framework rather than only mapped. The evidence pack is a single marketing line, though, and never names the specific artifacts the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation/management, certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
